name: Shoaling
author: E. T. Carter
description: Looking low across rippled indigo sand under clear shallow water: open cyan caustic filaments with violet fringes fold, pinch and slide across the ripple crests and over green algae-capped boulders and pebbles, thinning into a fine shimmering mesh toward a deep blue haze with faint light shafts and slow drifting motes.

params.label: Swell
params.effect: Height of the swell overhead: low gives soft broad light, high folds it into dense sharp filaments.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: How fast the swell travels and the caustics slide across the bed.

params.label: Sand ripples
params.effect: Height of the sand ripples, from a flat bed to deep ridged sand.

params.label: Light
params.effect: Brightness of the caustic light and the shafts.
